description: Private Agent memory and governed shared knowledge for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Private Agent memory plus reviewed shared knowledge.
interface.longDescription: Recall one Agent's private experience and governed Knowledge Editions through a local stdio MCP server. A default-off machine-wide switch covers both proactive Agent memory and Hook-triggered memory with shared value guidance and budget. Explicit requests use a sanitized request basis. Human governance uses ART's local page; shared knowledge remains separately governed.
defaultPrompt: Recall relevant private experience and reviewed knowledge for this task.
Save this bounded, sourced conclusion to my private Recall Trail.
